senses.definition: a crude uncouth ill-bred person lacking culture or refinement

quotations.english: a churl's close must be fenced

quotations.old_english: Swá we eác settaþ be eallum hádum, ge ceorle ge eorle
quotations.english: so also we ordain for all degrees, whether to churl or earl [gentle or simple]

quotations.old_english: Twelfhyndes mannes áþ forstent vi ceorla áþ
quotations.english: a twelve hundred man's oath stands for six churls' oaths
